title: Digital identity
answer_en: Use the Nafath application to verify your identity when accessing digital services. Never share your verification code or password.
source: Digital security awareness guide - project training content

title: Training programs
answer_en: Start by identifying the required skill, then review the program eligibility and registration dates with the provider before applying.
source: Training programs guide - project training content

title: Data privacy
answer_en: Collect only the data you need, explain why it is used, and store it securely with restricted access.
source: Privacy and responsible AI principles - project training content

title: Starting an AI project
answer_en: Define the problem and a measurable success metric, prepare suitable data, build a prototype, and test it before scaling.
source: AI solutions development methodology - project training content
